'''January 2001 Seattle tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Seattle, WA on 6 January 2001. [[Joe Olson]] won it. It is known from Douglas Harvilla's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1594">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-07-seattle-wa-1-6-01d1594/ seattle-wa-1-6-01], DeckTech (Douglas "Douglas" Harvilla, 7 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-07-seattle-wa-1-6-01d1594/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 6 January 2001
* '''Site:''' Seattle, WA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Joe Olson]]

== Discrepancies ==

Where a source disagrees with the record on this page, the page keeps the record and notes the difference here.

* Douglas Harvilla records his round 1 win over Denny Chapin as +22; Chapin writes that he lost 'by 13', and his running total after the game is −24.<ref name="tr-d1594" />
* Douglas Harvilla records his round 1 win over Denny Chapin as +22; Chapin writes that he lost 'by 13', and his running total after the game is −24.<ref name="tr-d1606" />
